runs.title: Reply before timeout
runs.description: Two client occurrences run independently. A second release of first.poll waits for its serial lock.

runs.title: Timeout and late reply
runs.description: The first request times out at 32 ms and its late reply is discarded at 36 ms. The queued activation remains open at the 40 ms observation boundary, before its 43 ms deadline.

runs.title: Open at the horizon
runs.description: The observation ends while callers await responses and one routed input awaits serial dispatch.

runs.title: Declared deadline missed
runs.description: The queued second activation misses its deadline. The run stops with pending intervals still open.
